title: Prepositional networks
subtitle: Follow linked phrases across one theological claim.
overview: A dense sentence may layer source, means, sphere, and goal through prepositional phrases. Map each phrase rather than translating them all as “in.”
Observe both the preposition and its case, then attach the phrase to the word or claim it modifies.

items.grc: ἐξ αὐτοῦ καὶ δι᾽ αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰς αὐτὸν τὰ πάντα.
items.en: From him and through him and to him are all things.

items.grc: ἐν αὐτῷ ἔχομεν τὴν ἀπολύτρωσιν διὰ τοῦ αἵματος αὐτοῦ.
items.en: In him we have redemption through his blood.
